##### Project general facts

Nobu Residences Al Marjan Island, envisioned by award‑winning architects John McAslan + Partners, delivers a collection of one‑, two‑ and three‑bedroom apartments together with garden duplexes, penthouses and private villas. The design embraces clean modernist lines that echo traditional Japanese simplicity, while floor‑to‑ceiling glazing and glass‑fronted balconies flood each home with natural light and showcase sweeping sea panoramas. Thoughtful landscaping at ground level and concealed parking beneath the towers reinforce the meticulous attention to detail synonymous with the Nobu brand.

Residents gain full access to the Nobu Hotel’s celebrated amenities and a curated programme of exclusive facilities crafted for refined coastal living. The development integrates wellness spaces, social lounges and leisure areas that complement the island’s tranquil ambience. Every amenity is positioned to maximise the surrounding seascape, reinforcing a sense of openness and serenity.

Hotel‑style apartments arrive fully furnished, whereas the residential units are offered unfurnished, allowing owners to personalise their space. Interiors, masterfully designed by the Rockwell Group, showcase clean lines, muted tones and natural textures that embody the Nobu philosophy of Japanese minimalism blended with local influences. Kitchens come equipped with appliances, ready for effortless culinary creation.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Marjan Island presents a striking man‑made archipelago in the emirate of Ras Al Khaimah, composed of four coral‑shaped islands linked by a central boulevard along the Arabian Gulf coastline. Its layout creates an expansive vista of turquoise waters that frames every view with an impression of limitless horizon. The setting has rapidly become a focal point for visitors seeking a distinctive seaside experience.

The shoreline features immaculate white beaches that extend for several kilometres, inviting sunbathers, swimmers and water‑sport enthusiasts alike. Crystal‑clear Gulf waters provide an ideal playground for jet‑skiing, paddle‑boarding and open‑water swimming. A dedicated promenade encourages leisurely walks and active pursuits amidst the coastal breeze.

A constellation of upscale hotels and resorts dots the island, each offering private beach access, inviting swimming pools, rejuvenating spas and gourmet dining venues. The island’s calendar brims with concerts, fireworks displays and cultural festivals that animate its vibrant social scene. Additionally, a purpose‑built outdoor fitness zone and jogging tracks support an active, health‑focused lifestyle for residents and guests.
